entities.name: Homocystinuria
observations: Classic homocystinuria due to cystathionine beta-synthase deficiency can cause marfanoid habitus, developmental delay, and inferior lens subluxation.

entities.name: CBS
observations: Cystathionine beta-synthase deficiency causes classic homocystinuria.

entities.name: Inferior ectopia lentis with delay
observations: Inferior lens dislocation with developmental delay and marfanoid features favors homocystinuria over FBN1-related Marfan syndrome.
